files.query: SELECT ?item ?icao ?iata ?label ?coord WHERE { { ?item wdt:P239 ?icao } UNION { ?item wdt:P238 ?iata } ?item rdfs:label ?label. FILTER(LANG(?label) IN ("zh","zh-hans","zh-hant","zh-cn","zh-tw")) OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P625 ?coord } }

SELECT ?country ?iso ?item ?label ?english WHERE { ?country wdt:P297 ?iso; wdt:P36 ?item. ?item rdfs:label ?label; rdfs:label ?english. FILTER(LANG(?english)="en") FILTER(LANG(?label) IN ("zh","zh-hans","zh-hant","zh-cn","zh-tw")) }

SELECT ?item ?code ?label ?alias WHERE { VALUES ?catalog { wd:Q14534 wd:Q741672 wd:Q14530 } ?item p:P528 ?statement. ?statement pq:P972 ?catalog; ps:P528 ?code. ?item rdfs:label ?label. FILTER(LANG(?label) IN ("zh","zh-hans","zh-hant","zh-cn","zh-tw")) OPTIONAL { ?item skos:altLabel ?alias. FILTER(LANG(?alias) IN ("zh","zh-hans","zh-hant","zh-cn","zh-tw")) } }
